asks.question: ab_verify.py _checkout() picks the Juxta platform dir for the Node target WebDemo (no .venv), so A/B [6/6] and the mutation control cannot run Playwright (MODULE_NOT_FOUND node_modules). Fix it in Juxta (prefer the target config checkout), or change the WebDemo target setup to link an absolute node_modules path?
asks.answer: Fix it in Juxta, never hard-code an absolute path in the WebDemo target.json: Devilbilly/Juxta#393 makes ab_verify A/B and mutation setup use the target config checkout (deployed 2026-09-27).

asks.question: For issue #6, may the README-only change use Traditional Chinese as required by its acceptance criteria, as an explicit exception to the English-only committed-content rule?
asks.answer: Use Traditional Chinese for the README section. The English-only policy applies to the Juxta repository, not application repositories; WebDemo follows its existing Traditional Chinese convention. The owner approved the proposed content.
